responseMessageContents.text: The user is saying their App Store submission didn't include screenshots or description. They need help with App Store metadata and screenshots. Let me read the relevant skill files and understand the current state of the project.

I can't directly modify your App Store submission — screenshots and description need to be added through **App Store Connect** manually. Here's what to do:

1. **Go to [App Store Connect](https://appstoreconnect.apple.com)** → My Apps → your app
2. **App Information / Description**: Paste your app description, subtitle, and keywords in the "App Store" tab under your app version
3. **Screenshots**: Upload screenshots under the "Media" section for each device size (6.7" iPhone, 6.5" iPhone, etc.)

If you need me to **generate App Store screenshots** or **write the App Store description/metadata** for you, I can do that — just let me know which one you need (or both) and I'll get started.
